alerts.title: L-Taraval Delayed at Taraval/23Rd.
alerts.description: As of 9:39 AM, SF Muni reports inbound & outbound L-Taraval delayed at Taraval/23Rd, due to downed overhead wires. Bus shuttles are being arranged to provide service between the zoo & West Portal.
